About Astha Jain & her Preparation Journey
Astha Jain belongs to Shamli district in the state of Uttar Pradesh.
She finished her schooling at Scottish International School, Shamli & pursued B.A. from Delhi University in 2022.
She actively participated in discussions on governance and held leadership roles during college.
Astha Jain secured AIR 131 in CSE 2023, secured AIR 186 in CSE 2024 & finally got AIR 9 in CSE 2025 .
She found her inspiration in serving society or NGOs and managed her responsibilities while preparing for the exam.
